question: Sound travels in a medium as a-
solution:
The correct answer is __**Series of compressions and rarefactions.**__

 
• Sound travels in a medium as a series of compressions and rarefactions.
 
• A medium is necessary for sound to travel.
 
• Sound waves can't travel through vacuum.
 
• Sound travels faster in solids.
 
• Study of sound: **Acoustics**
 
• Speed of sound in air: **~343 m/s**
 
• Unit of frequency of sound: **Hertz(Hz)**
 
• Unit of Intensity of sound: **Decibels(dB)**
